tickEnd: Minecraft.tick(): connection.send(ServerboundClientTickEndPacket.INSTANCE) when a connection exists and the game is not paused
frame: Minecraft.runTick: advanceGameTime(Util.getMillis()) -> packetProcessor.processQueuedPackets() -> runAllTasks() -> for (j < min(10, owed)) tick(); DeltaTracker.Timer.advanceGameTime returns (int) residual and subtracts it (owed ticks beyond 10 are dropped); tick() has one caller
timer: Minecraft.<init>: new DeltaTracker.Timer(20.0f, ...); getTickTargetMillis(f) = runsNormally ? max(f, TickRateManager.millisecondsPerTick()) : f
fences: handlePing: PacketUtils.ensureRunningOnSameThread then send(new ServerboundPongPacket(id)) - the pong is a GAME-thread write; handleKeepAlive: no ensureRunningOnSameThread (network thread, never a fence); handleMovePlayer/RotatePlayer/TeleportEntity/TickingState/SetEntityMotion/Explosion: game thread; Connection.sendPacket: eventLoop.execute off-loop (one FIFO per writing thread)
